action.objective: Play Qb4, activating the queen to pressure d4/b7 and keep the initiative without allowing a forced mate.
action.rationale: Qb4 is the only commit-ready move: verified at depth 2 with exact score -25, safety.complete true, no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found. It develops the queen actively. Alternative d2f4 was slightly worse (-32, upper bound) with less verification. Black's captures (Qxa2, Bxg4, Rxd3, Rxh2) win loose pawns but no forced mate is shown; position remains playable.
